shortDescription: Mexico’s fiscal deficit would narrow next year even as the government plans more funding for public works, according to Bloomberg.The 2027 budget blueprint from leftist President Claudia Sheinbaum calls for the tighter deficit alongside higher spending on public works.

children: Mexico’s fiscal deficit would narrow next year even as the government plans more funding for public works, according to Bloomberg.
The 2027 budget blueprint from leftist President Claudia Sheinbaum calls for the tighter deficit alongside higher spending on public works.

title: Mexico’s 2027 Budget Blueprint Targets Smaller Deficit and More Public Works
